scripts.docker:frontend:install: docker compose exec frontend npm install
scripts.docker:stats:clear: docker compose exec app npm run stats:clear
scripts.docker:test: bash -ceu 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=language-cards-test; if docker container inspect "$TEST_DATABASE_CONTAINER_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker rm --force "$TEST_DATABASE_CONTAINER_NAME" >/dev/null; fi; docker run --detach --name "$TEST_DATABASE_CONTAINER_NAME" --env POSTGRES_DB="$TEST_DATABASE_NAME" --env POSTGRES_USER="$TEST_DATABASE_USER" --env POSTGRES_PASSWORD="$TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD" --publish "$TEST_DATABASE_HOST_PORT:5432" "$TEST_DATABASE_IMAGE" >/dev/null; until docker exec "$TEST_DATABASE_CONTAINER_NAME" pg_isready --username="$TEST_DATABASE_USER" --dbname="$TEST_DATABASE_NAME" >/dev/null; do sleep 1; done; export BASE_DATABASE_URL="postgresql://$TEST_DATABASE_USER:$TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD@host.docker.internal:$TEST_DATABASE_HOST_PORT/$TEST_DATABASE_NAME?schema=public" BASE_TRANSLATOR_APP_TYPE=mock BASE_DEFINER_APP_TYPE=mock BASE_LLM_PROVIDER=mock TRANSLATOR_LLM_PROVIDER=mock DEFINER_LLM_PROVIDER=mock IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX=test-; if docker compose up --detach; then :; fi; attempt=0; until curl --fail --silent "http://localhost:$TRAEFIK_PORT/en" >/dev/null; do attempt=$((attempt + 1)); if [ "$attempt" -eq 60 ]; then exit 1; fi; sleep 1; done'
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:run-with-docker: bash -ceu 'set -a; . ./.env; set +a; export COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME=language-cards-test IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX=test- DATABASE_URL="postgresql://$TEST_DATABASE_USER:$TEST_DATABASE_PASSWORD@localhost:$TEST_DATABASE_HOST_PORT/$TEST_DATABASE_NAME?schema=public"; trap "if docker compose down --remove-orphans; then :; fi; if docker container inspect \"$TEST_DATABASE_CONTAINER_NAME\" >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker rm --force \"$TEST_DATABASE_CONTAINER_NAME\" >/dev/null; fi" EXIT; npm run docker:test; export BASE_MERCURE_URL=http://localhost:9090/.well-known/mercure BASE_REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380 TRANSLATOR_CACHE_URL=redis://localhost:6380/1 DEFINER_CACHE_URL=redis://localhost:6380/2 LLM_CACHE_URL=redis://localhost:6380/3; npm run test'
scripts.test:e2e: npm run --prefix base test:e2e && npm run --prefix frontend test:e2e
scripts.test:ts: npm run --prefix base test:ts && npm run --prefix definer test:ts && npm run --prefix translator test:ts && npm run --prefix llm test:ts && npm run --prefix frontend test:ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run --prefix base test:unit && npm run --prefix definer test && npm run --prefix translator test && npm run --prefix llm test && npm run --prefix frontend test:unit
